title: 1997 Greer briefing with Admiral Wilson
summary: UAPGerb tells of 1997 Greer briefing with Admiral Wilson, about 1997 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: 1997 was when the Greer Will Miller uh Thomas Wilson Steven Lovekin meeting took place.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that in 1997 a meeting took place in Washington, DC, between Steven Greer, a campaigner for UFO disclosure, Willard Miller, Admiral Thomas Wilson, a senior Navy officer, and Stephen Lovekin. He describes it as a briefing on the subject of UFOs. If true, it would mean a high-ranking officer was being told about secret UFO matters.
